findings.title: Completion setup fails when ordered around compinit incorrectly
findings.why_it_matters: Users who append the recommended fpath assignment to an existing .zshrc after compinit will not get rg completion because compinit has already scanned fpath. Conversely, putting the dynamic source before compinit calls _rg without completion initialization and never registers it. The instructions need to give the required ordering so either installation works with an existing zsh setup.
findings.suggested_fix: Tell users to add the fpath entry before compinit and source the generated script after compinit, showing initialization if needed.
evidence: FAQ.md:131-135 tells users to add source <(rg --generate complete-zsh) to .zshrc without specifying its position relative to compinit.
crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:441-444 invokes _rg if compdef is absent and only registers the function if compdef is already defined.
